note: wstream — wire-streaming matrix. Captures STREAMING behavior (the harness's real path) across the model x api_backend x wire cross-product via the dogfood hermetic-home mechanism (live config copy + per-cell api_backend patch + wiretap2 -> real proxy + headless streaming turn). Invariants pin known W10 behavior (status/route/model-calls); observations capture the W10 open questions the harness can reach. FROZEN per-run config is the derived-config.toml written to each cell's report dir (we do not store full 293-line config copies — the derivation is live-config + a declared api_backend patch, captured per-run).
cross_product: model x api_backend x wire (SELECTIVE — 6 frontier models x native + targeted overrides; not full enumeration)
mechanism: smoke/wstream/run.py (self-contained; pattern source smoke/redteam/run.py + smoke/wiretap/wiretap.py + smoke/redteam/grok-dogfood.v2; NOT imported to stay decoupled from the actively-edited redteam lane)
